people.name: Naphtali
people.line: Son of Jacob, founder of the tribe of Naphtali.

people.name: Zebulun
people.line: Israelite tribe, son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: Zebulun was a people that jeopardized their lives to the death; Naphtali also, on the high places of the field.
translations.bsb: Zebulun was a people who risked their lives; Naphtali, too, on the heights of the battlefield.
translations.kjv: Zebulun and Naphtali were a people that jeoparded their lives unto the death in the high places of the field.
translations.asv: Zebulun was a people that jeoparded their lives unto the death, And Naphtali, upon the high places of the field.
